description.value: Aphrodite's is a Kitsilano institution and a founding force in Vancouver's organic and sustainable food movement, operating since 2003 out of a cozy heritage building at 4th and Dunbar. The pie shop is renowned for handmade pies crafted entirely from local organic ingredients — fruits, Anita's Organic flour, Avalon Dairy cream — with over 14 varieties including gluten-friendly and vegan options. Cyclists riding the popular West 4th Avenue corridor will find a welcoming neighbourhood spot for brunch, coffee, and a slice of pie, with online ordering available for takeout.
